name: UI Icons Form element
description: Core Icons main form element for Icon autocomplete; generic icon manager that integrates third-party icon packs across Drupal's display tools on top of core's Icon API.
submodules: ui_icons_field: Provides an Icon field type (ui_icon, main property target_id) and Link field integration.
ui_icons_field_link_attributes: Link-with-attributes (link_attributes) integration for icon fields (nested under ui_icons_field).
ui_icons_field_linkit: Linkit integration for icon fields (nested under ui_icons_field).
ui_icons_field_linkit_attributes: Linkit-with-attributes integration for icon fields (nested under ui_icons_field).
ui_icons_canvas: NEW in 2.0 — makes the ui_icon field/icon_widget editable as a Drupal Canvas component input.
ui_icons_media: Media integration allowing icons as a media type.
ui_icons_picker: Fancy modal grid icon picker widget (icon_picker element) for the UI Icons selector.
ui_icons_library: Admin overview page listing all icons available on the site (ships a permission).
ui_icons_font: FontExtractor plugin to define icon packs from web fonts.
ui_icons_text: Text-filter (icon_embed) integration to embed icons in filtered content via <drupal-icon>.
ui_icons_menu: Menu UI integration to attach icons to menu links.
ui_icons_ckeditor5: CKEditor 5 plugin/button to embed icons in rich text (produces <drupal-icon>).
ui_icons_patterns: Icons integration with UI Patterns 2.x only (1.x SettingType support dropped).
